name: Pollinator Meadow FX textures
generator: src/build-fx.mjs (+ src/build-fx-extra.mjs for spritesheets/ui, src/build-fx-breeze.mjs for scrolling)
alpha: straight (non-premultiplied); transparent pixels carry bled edge colour so filtering/mipmaps show no dark fringes

particles.desc: pale blue-white teardrop; tint for rain/sprinkler
white-gold 4-point sparkle with glow; tint freely
fresh green leaf with vein; rotate per particle
soft cream puff; tint to ground colour
white cartoon puff flecked with pollen
white silk strand with dew beads, fades at both ends; stretch along X

glow.desc: white radial glow, RGB=255 everywhere so straight and premultiplied use match; alpha 0 at the rim

emblems.desc: slate grey, rounded square, ringed bands

spritesheets.order: row-major: left-to-right, then top-to-bottom; frame 1 top-left = pop starts, frame 16 bottom-right = faded out
spritesheets.desc: Wobble pop: a structure/critter bursts into planks, petals and confetti that fly out, tumble and fade. Play once at ~20-30 fps (0.55-0.8 s).

ui.method: radial-fill shader (angle computed from UV; no extra texture needed). Fill = white band, tint it in the shader (multiply) - ink edges stay dark.
ui.shader:
vec2 d = vUv - 0.5; float a = fract(atan(d.x, d.y) / 6.28318531); // three.js default flipY=true: 0 at 12 o'clock, clockwise
 if (a > uProgress) discard; // or draw the track: col = mix(trackTint, fillTint, step(a, uProgress))  (if flipY=false use atan(d.x, -d.y))
ui.desc: Goal/progress ring: white tintable band with ink edges on transparent.

ui.channels: RGB = clockwise angle from 12 o'clock (0..255 = 0..1), A = ring mask
ui.method: alpha-test / threshold fill without trig: show pixel if angle.r <= progress. Use NearestFilter (or skip mipmaps) to avoid a seam where 255 meets 0 at 12 o'clock.

scrolling.scrolling: Use on a lane quad/ribbon whose U runs along the wind. wrapS = wrapT = RepeatWrapping; repeat.x = laneLength / 8 (1 tile ~ 8 m), repeat.y = 1 (or laneWidth / 8). Scroll: map.offset.x -= dt * windSpeed / 8 (2 layers at speed x1.0 and x1.6 with repeat 1 and 1.3, the second offset.y 0.37, read as depth). Fade the lane ends with a vertex alpha / alphaMap ramp and fade the whole lane in 0.3 s at gust start, out 0.5 s at stop (4 s gust). depthWrite false, transparent true, side DoubleSide; optional slight vertical bob: offset.y = 0.02*sin(t*1.7). For a gust the other way, rotate the lane 180 deg (do not flip U, the streak heads would point upwind).
scrolling.desc: Gusty Breeze lane: soft cream wind streaks + 14 blown leaves (greens to autumn orange) with motion trails, ink outlines like leaf-flutter.png. Transparent background; straight alpha with wrap-aware colour bleed.
